identity.name: TAXXA
identity.description: A government-backed lottery platform that feels like a high-end fintech game. It balances the seriousness of tax compliance with the dopamine of winning.
identity.emotional_archetype: Archetype 6: Vibrant Play (Gamified) + Archetype 4: Swiss High-Contrast (Trust)
design_principles: Fusion: Government Official x Casino Excitement
Emotion First: Scanning a receipt should feel like buying a winning ticket
Content is King: The 'Next Draw' countdown is the heartbeat of the app
Negative Space: Don't clutter. Let the prize money breathe
Contrast: High contrast for accessibility and excitement (Dark 'Winning' sections vs Light 'Dashboard')

headings.usage: Use for all major headings. Tight tracking (-0.02em).

body.usage: Use for all UI text, labels, and data. Excellent legibility.

mono.usage: Use for ticket numbers, receipt IDs, and countdown timers.

primary.description: Emerald-600. Represents Growth, Money, and Tanzania Green.

secondary.description: Amber-500. Represents Gold, Prizes, and Winning.

accent.description: Royal Blue-600. Represents Official Government Trust.

usage_rules: Do NOT use gradients for text.
Use 'Gold Rush' gradient ONLY for winning tickets/prizes.
Use 'Emerald City' for success states and primary CTAs.
Backgrounds should be solid #F8FAFC or White with subtle noise texture.

textures: Noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on all solid backgrounds to prevent digital flatness.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl transition-all hover:-translate-y-0.5
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-primary border-2 border-primary hover:bg-primary/5 transition-all
buttons.gold: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 text-black font-bold shadow-glow hover:shadow-gold/50 transition-all scale-100 hover:scale-105

cards.default: bg-white border border-border shadow-card rounded-2xl p-6
cards.ticket: bg-white border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 relative rounded-lg p-6 mask-ticket
cards.dark_highlight: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 relative overflow-hidden

scanner_fab.style: fixed bottom-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 w-16 h-16 bg-primary rounded-full shadow-2xl flex items-center justify-center z-50 border-4 border-white hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer

assets.description: Happy user checking phone (Use for landing page hero or success modal)
Context shot for scanning (Use for 'How it works' or scanner onboarding)
Man celebrating win (Use for testimonials or 'Recent Winners' section)

universal_guidelines: NEVER use generic gradients for text.
The Scanner button must be the most prominent element on mobile.
All interactive elements must have a hover state.
Ensure high contrast for accessibility (WCAG AA compliant).
Use a subtle noise texture on the background to avoid 'digital flatness'.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install fonts 'Outfit' and 'Public Sans' via Google Fonts or Fontsource. Install 'canvas-confetti' for celebrations.
instructions_to_main_agent.theming: Update tailwind.config.js with the custom color palette provided.
instructions_to_main_agent.components: Prioritize building the 'TicketCard' and 'ScannerFAB' components as they are core to the experience.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout: Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy for the dashboard. It shouldn't look like a spreadsheet.
instructions_to_main_agent.interactions: Add micro-interactions. When a user scans, vibrate (if possible) or show a visual pulse.
